note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Seven pictures chosen by eye from 13 trial pictures (a1-oak, b1-overboard, c1-bed, d1-hands, e1-weep, f1-day were not used). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God, the adversary and the heavenly court are not pictured, Job, his wife and his friends are not portrayed as biblical people but shown through ordinary people of today, and nothing violent or gruesome is shown (his sores are shown as bandages).
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures.

sections.meaning: Job still holds fast to his integrity after losing everything, and now the test reaches his own body: will a man still bless God when his own flesh and life are touched?
ideas: After the storm, in a field of blown-down trees, the one straight oak from before still stands upright, stripped and battered but unbowed
A grey-haired man stands straight and calm in front of his storm-wrecked farmhouse
A man's hand keeps its firm grip on a rope in driving wind and rain
A lighthouse still standing as huge waves break over it
A doctor holds an X-ray of a man's ribs and spine up to a light box while the grey-haired patient looks on gravely
A man on a sinking boat throws his suitcases and belongings overboard to stay afloat
A man runs out of a burning house carrying nothing at all
A stethoscope is pressed to an older man's chest in a plain clinic
Weathered hands with the first red sores appearing on the skin
An anchor chain pulled tight in a storm, still holding

sections.meaning: His own body is struck from head to foot, and he sits in the ashes, alone with his pain.
ideas: A grey-haired man with bandaged arms and neck sits alone in the grey ash of his burned-out house, scraping his arm with a broken piece of a clay pot
A grey-haired man with bandaged arms, neck and feet sits alone on the edge of a hospital bed, head bowed
A broken piece of a clay pot lying in a heap of grey ash
A man sits by the cold ashes of a fire at night, alone
A man in bandages sits on the curb outside a burned-out house
A bandaged man sits on a heap at the town dump among broken things
A man's bandaged feet on cold ashes
A hospital window at night with one lamp lit
A man scratches his arm, sleepless, at a kitchen table at night
A man wrapped in a blanket on the steps of an empty house

sections.meaning: Even when the one closest to him tells him to give up on God, Job takes the bad from God as he took the good, and does not sin with his lips.
ideas: In the ashes, his wife kneels beside him in tears, gripping his arm and pleading, while he looks back at her steadily and gently
An old man's two open hands held out side by side, one holding a ripe peach and the other a thorny bramble twig
A wife turns away in anger and despair at the door while her husband sits quietly
A man sits in the ashes and gives thanks over a single crust of bread
A field half in sunshine and half under rain, the farmer standing in the middle with open hands
A married couple sit apart on the steps of a burned-out house, she weeping, he calm
A man keeps his lips closed and his eyes calm while someone shouts at him
Two cups on a table, one sweet and one bitter, and a hand taking up the bitter one
A tree half in blossom and half bare
An old man lifts his face to rain as he once lifted it to the sun

sections.meaning: His friends come from far away to grieve with him, cannot even recognize him, and sit with him on the ground in silence, because his pain is too great for words.
ideas: Three men walk up a long dirt road toward a distant figure hunched alone in the ashes; the nearest stops with his hand over his mouth
Three friends with travel bags meet at a small country bus stop and embrace with grave faces
Three men stopped on a road, staring ahead in grief, one weeping with his face in his hands
Four men sit silently on the bare ground in a circle beside the ashes under the night stars, a single lantern between them
Four men sit side by side on the ground in grey morning light, shoulders touching, no one speaking
Three cars from three directions arriving at the same lonely crossroads
Friends sitting silently in a hospital waiting room
A friend's hand resting on a bandaged shoulder
Four empty folding chairs left out in the ashes at dawn
Stars wheeling over four still figures sitting on the ground

scenes.principle: He is still holding fast to his blamelessness after everything was taken from him.
scenes.shows: A grey-haired man stands straight and calm in front of his storm-wrecked farmhouse, its roof torn away.
scenes.prompt: In the yard of a storm-wrecked farm, a grey-haired man in a plain work shirt stands straight and upright in front of his ruined farmhouse, its roof torn away, with broken fences and scattered boards behind him. His face is calm and steady and his hands hang at his sides. Overcast morning light as the storm clouds move away.

scenes.principle: Now the test reaches his own body: touch his bone and his flesh.
scenes.shows: A doctor holds an X-ray of a man's ribs and spine up to a light box while the grey-haired patient looks on gravely.
scenes.prompt: In a plain clinic room, a doctor in a white coat holds an X-ray picture of a man's ribs and spine up against a bright light box on the wall. A grey-haired man sits on the edge of the exam table in a plain shirt, looking at the X-ray with a grave, quiet face. Cool daylight from a window. The X-ray has no writing or marks on it.

scenes.principle: Struck with sores from head to foot, he sits among the ashes with a piece of broken pottery.
scenes.shows: A grey-haired man with bandaged arms sits alone in the ashes of his burned-down house, a broken piece of a clay pot in his hand.
scenes.prompt: A grey-haired man sits alone on the ground in a wide heap of grey ash where his house has burned down, a few blackened beams standing behind him. His arms, hands and neck are wrapped in clean white bandages. Resting in his open hand is a broken piece of a plain clay pot. His head is bowed and his shoulders are slumped in weariness. Dull overcast light, a few wisps of ash drifting in the air.

scenes.principle: His wife tells him to curse God and die; he answers that we accept the bad from God as well as the good, and does not sin with his lips.
scenes.shows: In the ashes his wife kneels beside him in tears, gripping his arm and pleading, while he looks back at her steadily and gently.
scenes.prompt: On the grey ash-covered ground of a burned-out home, a grey-haired man with bandaged arms sits quietly. His wife kneels close beside him in tears, gripping his arm and pleading with him, her face full of grief and despair. He turns to her and looks back at her steadily and gently, calm. Overcast daylight.

scenes.principle: His three friends meet together by arrangement to come to grieve with him and comfort him.
scenes.shows: Three men with travel bags meet at a country bus stop and embrace with grave, sorrowful faces.
scenes.prompt: At a small country bus stop, three middle-aged men with travel bags, each just arrived from his own town, meet and embrace one another with grave, sorrowful faces. Plain daylight, an empty road stretching away behind them.

scenes.principle: From far off they do not recognize him, and they weep aloud.
scenes.shows: Three men on a dirt road stop and weep as they see a lone figure hunched on a heap of ash far ahead.
scenes.prompt: Three middle-aged men in plain coats walk up a long dirt road toward a distant figure who sits hunched alone on a grey heap of ash beside a burned-out house. The nearest of the three has stopped with his hand over his mouth in shock, and another is starting to weep. We see them from slightly behind, at the side of the road, with the lone figure small in the distance ahead of them. Grey afternoon light.

scenes.principle: They sit with him on the ground seven days and seven nights without a word, for his pain is very great.
scenes.shows: Under a starry night sky four men sit silently on the bare ground round a single lantern, one of them with bandaged arms.
scenes.prompt: At night under a sky full of stars, four men sit silently on the bare ground in a small circle beside a grey heap of ash, with a single lantern on the ground between them. One of them, with bandaged arms, sits hunched; the other three sit close around him with their heads bowed, saying nothing. Seen from a low angle at their eye level. Quiet, still, deep blue night light.
